const AiDotNet.Tensors.Engines.DirectGpu.Metal.MetalKernels.HyperbolicKernels = "\n#include <metal_stdlib>\n#include <metal_math>\nusing namespace metal;\n\n// Constants\nconstant float EPSILON = 1e-7f;\nconstant float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;\nconstant float SQRT_2_OVER_PI = 0.7978845608028654f;\nconstant float GELU_COEF = 0.044715f;\n\n// Helper functions\ninline float sigmoid(float x) {\n    return 1.0f / (1.0f + exp(-x));\n}\n\ninline float safe_divide(float a, float b) {\n    return a / (b + EPSILON);\n}\n\n// IEEE-754 binary32: the bits other than the sign, and +Inf's bit pattern. const AiDotNet.Tensors.Engines.DirectGpu.Metal.MetalKernels.LossKernels = "\n#include <metal_stdlib>\n#include <metal_math>\nusing namespace metal;\n\n// Constants\nconstant float EPSILON = 1e-7f;\nconstant float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;\nconstant float SQRT_2_OVER_PI = 0.7978845608028654f;\nconstant float GELU_COEF = 0.044715f;\n\n// Helper functions\ninline float sigmoid(float x) {\n    return 1.0f / (1.0f + exp(-x));\n}\n\ninline float safe_divide(float a, float b) {\n    return a / (b + EPSILON);\n}\n\n// IEEE-754 binary32: the bits other than the sign, and +Inf's bit pattern.
